features.feature_value: Remove when content includes abusive language/profanity
features.evidence_span: "If there was abusive language, they should absolutely not be allowed."
features.rationale: The participant states an explicit prohibition tied to abusive language.

features.feature_value: Keep most views due to free speech, but remove based on vulgar/foul language
features.evidence_span: "I only removed... solely based on vulgarity or foul language."
features.rationale: They describe removals being driven specifically by vulgarity/foul language while citing the First Amendment.

features.feature_value: Allow even if disagreeing; disallow violence or cursing
features.evidence_span: "What I don't allow is violence or cursing"
features.rationale: They set a two-part allowance/removal rule centered on violence and cursing.

features.feature_value: As moderator, do not allow posts containing foul language
features.evidence_span: "As a moderator, I do not feel posts that contain the use of foul language should be supported"
features.rationale: They explicitly tie their moderation decision to foul language and their moderator perspective.

features.feature_value: Remove posts with personal threats or extremely vulgar language; allow opinions
features.evidence_span: "removed posts which made personal threats or used extremely vulgar language"
features.rationale: They define removal criteria around personal threats and intense vulgarity while allowing opinion expression.

features.feature_value: Profanity/presence of profanity makes them reflect on how people talk
features.evidence_span: "I wasnt expecting such profanity... it made me think"
features.rationale: Their reflection links unexpected profanity to an emotional/cognitive impact (thinking about discourse behavior).

features.feature_value: Judges based on who would plausibly say it; may lean but claims good sentence analysis
features.evidence_span: "I was just thinking about the typical person I would believe would be saying it."
features.rationale: They describe a strategy using plausibility of the speaker to inform judgments.

features.feature_value: Avoid content that is argumentative/condescending/rude to keep politics discussion civil
features.evidence_span: "anything that was argumentative, condescending, rude or negative would not be helpful"
features.rationale: They identify specific interpersonal tone cues as reasons to reject/remove.
